proof.text: Apply exists_picardUniversalRankMatchLocus_finitePresentation_core to f and E. It supplies W and j with an immersion proof, a local finite presentation proof, and the exact universal rank-match factorization equivalence. Retain W, j and the immersion proof, and discard local finite presentation. The core condition is the abbreviation of PicardUniversalRankMatch, so the universal property has the required type by definitional equality. The structure-pushforward hypothesis is not needed for this stronger construction.
